reviewMethod: Compared the validator signal with the exact cited regulation page and clause, the complete R3 registry, ontology domains/ranges, and requirement dependency contract. Model feedback alone was not accepted as evidence.

TRF-031.rationale: The clause requires the von Mises comparison and beam-theory shear formula. R3 already contains vonMisesYieldCriterion, combinedBendingShearStress, yieldPoint, beamTheoryUsed, allowableShearStress, and yieldShearStress. A new controlled-value node is not necessary to represent the requirement.

I2-005.rationale: The source defines the boundary as the point where shell inclination is 7 degrees. R3 only has a ship-level/string bottomRegionLowerRegionBoundary and a generic shellInclinationAngle; it has no boundary-point class or ship-to-boundary-point relationship capable of binding the angle to that point.

I2-019.rationale: R3 already represents the structural member, hasSpannedHullArea path to hullAreaValue, each hullAreaFactor, and selectedHullAreaFactor on the structural member. These terms can encode selection of the largest applicable factor.

IMO-002.rationale: R3 already contains shipCategory with polarShipCategoryA/B/C, plus iceTypeClassification, iceTypeValue, and thinFirstYearIce. The initial scoped context omitted some existing terms, but no concept is absent from R3.

IMO-005.rationale: R3 already contains iceConditionClassification, iceConditionValue, iceFreeIceCondition, and totalIcePresent. The signal concerned the stress-test shape IRI rather than absent regulatory vocabulary.

IMO-043.rationale: R3 already contains machinery-installation and associated-equipment nodes, applicable hazard values and relationships, hazardProtectionCoverage, and hasHazardProtectionEvidence. The clause can be represented without another hazard-to-evidence predicate.

IMO-050.rationale: R3 already contains fireSafetyComponent, fireSafetyComponentExposed, and iceAndSnowProtectionPresent. The signal was solely an unapproved stress-test shape identifier.

IMO-086.rationale: The source requires two distinct non-magnetic heading means and requires both to be independent and each connected to main and emergency power. R3 has only an aggregate count/independence flag and generic power predicates, with no non-magnetic-heading-means class or ship-to-means inventory path.

IMO-116.rationale: R3 already represents applicability with notComminutedOrDisinfected and contains sewageDischargeType, MARPOL compliance, both distance concepts, and ice concentration. A separate controlled value is optional, not necessary for faithful representation.
